metadata.description: Claude Code mods (TypeScript plugins) for the prompt band, panes, plan tracking and model fit

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: Counts down until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, with optional keep-warm ping

plugins.name: chat-deck
plugins.description: Live agent dashboard pane: model vitals, plan, git, permission checks, subagent cards

plugins.name: chat-handoff
plugins.description: Offers a Refresh handoff of the whole chat at a token threshold

plugins.name: model-fit
plugins.description: Checks whether the model and effort fit the task and offers a Switch button
